turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've just retired and I want a project. I'm thinking of restoring an old classic car.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That sounds like a wonderful hobby. Do you have a garage to work in, and some mechanical experience?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to finally declutter the whole flat and I can't decide on a method.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Doing one room every weekend until the whole place is done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A thirty-day challenge, getting rid of one item on day one, two on day two, and so on.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Packing everything I don't use daily into boxes and only unpacking what I actually need.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or paying a professional organiser to come for a day and push me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the final one, I'm done. Your verdict?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: One room per weekend is steady and easy to plan. The thirty-day challenge is fun but ramps up fast, the packing method is the most brutal and effective, and the organiser is great if you need someone to keep you going.
